fills.researcher_notes: Total project investment for the whole WEP2 system: 1422亿元 = 142,200,000,000 RMB (SegmentCost is carried in full currency units in this tracker; SegmentCostUnits is the bare currency code per the locked vocabulary). Five sources across four origins and three document classes: NEA/人民日报 2012 ('西二线1422亿元' in an explicit 西一线-vs-西二线 investment breakdown), 经济日报 2010 ('总投资约1422亿元'), 十堰日报 2008-11-25 ('项目总投资1422亿元'), Xinhua's 2008-02-22 wire in English ('will cost 142.2 billion yuan (about US$20 billion)') and SCMP ('The project cost 142 billion yuan'). 人民网上海 2021 adds '1422亿元投资成为中国单体投资最大油气管道工程'. AGGREGATE-VS-SEGMENT CHECK: 1422亿 is the SYSTEM figure and this row IS the system, so it is at the right granularity — but it must NOT be pasted onto any WEP2 branch row. The two MEE 竣工验收 letters give the SECTION totals 538.04亿元 (西段) and 630.24亿元 (东段), which sum to 1168.28亿元; the ~254亿元 remainder is the branch/联络线 scope completed outside those two acceptance packages. SegmentCostYear left BLANK deliberately: every source states 1422亿元 as the announced total project investment (first published at the 2008-02-22 groundbreaking and repeated unchanged through 2021) and none states a price base year — filling one would be fabrication.

fills.researcher_notes: WEP2's design supply is imported Central Asian gas delivered at Khorgas by the Central Asia–China Gas Pipeline. Wording chosen to match the sibling WEP2 row P5961, which already carries FuelSource = 'Gas in Central Asia' — no new phrasing is introduced into the tracker. Four independent origins in three document classes: NEA 2012-11-05 is the most specific ('与中亚天然气管道A、B线相连接' — i.e. GEM's P2299 Line A and P2300 Line B), NDRC 2016 states it as a regulator ('西二线2012年全线投运，以中亚天然气为主力气源'), 人民日报《中国能源报》 2023 ('气源来自中亚进口天然气'), and 界面新闻 ('气源来自中亚天然气'). 陆家嘴金融网/西部管道 adds the upstream geography ('向西与横跨土库曼斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦和哈萨克斯坦三国的中亚天然气管道相连') and gov.cn 2012-12-31 the commodity at delivery ('来自中亚土库曼斯坦的天然气'). NEA 2012-09-24 words it as '主供气源来自土库曼斯坆' (Turkmenistan) — the same fact one step upstream, not a conflict. The gov.cn item is a SECTION document (广州-南宁支干线) and is cited for supply source only, never for a mainline spec. fills.researcher_notes: STAGED AT 12 MPa, BUT THE SYSTEM DOES NOT HAVE ONE UNIFORM MAINLINE PRESSURE — read the __VALIDITY__ before pasting. Whole-line evidence: 陆家嘴金融网 carrying 西部管道's own 西二线投产十周年 feature describes the line as '管材X80高钢级、管径1219毫米大口径，12兆帕高压力，年输气量300亿立方米，主要包括1条干线和8条支干线' and calls 12兆帕 '长输管道压力全球第一'; 人民网上海 2021 calls WEP2 China's '压力最高' gas pipeline without giving the number. Section evidence: MEE 环验〔2015〕227号 (西段, 霍尔果斯→靖边) '干线管径为1219毫米、设计压力12兆帕' — but MEE 环验〔2016〕100号 (东段, 麟游→广州从化) gives '干线管径1219毫米，设计压力10兆帕'. So 12 MPa is the design pressure of the WESTERN mainline and the headline figure for the system; the EASTERN mainline is 10 MPa, as are all 支干线/联络线 in both acceptance letters. Tier is medium, independent false: the two refs are not independent confirmations of one number — one is a whole-line statement, one a section document, and the second whole-line source (人民网) omits the figure. Rejected: ncsti.gov.cn's '压力10~12兆帕' line, whose surrounding block (工程为1干1支，总长度为4661千米…与西二线并行约3000千米) is internally self-contradictory and actually describes another line. Searched for a PipeChina/CNPC whole-line design-pressure statement; cnpc.com.cn returns 412 (WAF) and has no Wayback capture of its 西气东输 page.

fills.researcher_notes: ProposalYear 2007. 求是网 2024-10-21 ('西气东输二线于2007年启动，2011年投入运营') and China Daily 2022-01-04 ('2007年，西气东输二线工程正式启动，2011年投入运营') both state it while naming the line, but their wording is near-identical, so they are treated as ONE origin — tier medium, independent false, not high. Independent CONTEMPORANEOUS corroboration exists and is described here rather than cited, because it fails the name test: the Wayback capture of Xinhua English 2007-04-06 'CNPC plans to build longest LNG pipeline' (https://web.archive.org/web/20121008124425/http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2007-04/06/content_5942133.htm) reports the plan four months into 2007 with this project's unmistakable specs — CNPC-operated, from northwest Xinjiang to Guangzhou, gas from Turkmenistan and Kazakhstan, 'annual capacity of 30 billion cubic meters', construction 'planned to start next year' — but it calls the project only 'China's longest natural gas pipeline' and uses 'West-East pipeline' for WEP1, so it never names THIS row (proposal-stage figures of 6,500 km / 80亿元 also differ from as-built, as expected at that stage). PetroChina's 2007 annual report (March 2008) lists 西气东输二线 among the 2008 capex projects, confirming the project was a funded plan by end-2007. Downstream anchors: MEE records the EIA approval as 环审〔2008〕18号 (January 2008) for the west section and 环审〔2008〕318号 (August 2008) for the east, and construction began 2008-02 — both consistent with a 2007 proposal. ProposalMonth left BLANK: no source states a month, and the April 2007 Xinhua dateline is the earliest located public announcement, not a stated proposal date.
